Priya (AE): Heads up — BigBank asking for an on-prem air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed deliverables, a predictable upgrade cadence (customer controls when to apply), SBOM + provenance, and a short operator runbook. They want commercial options before Friday.
Omar (SE): Got it. Need to confirm artifact sizes and whether we can produce delta/minibundles for model updates. Also need clarity on licensing model for offline deployments.
Mei (Infra Eng): Tech constraints: our offline installer supports chunked minibundles and full bundles. Typical numbers: 7B q4 -> model ~600MB, 13B q4 -> ~1.1GB. Runtime+operators add ~400MB. Transfer method: USB drive or secure jump-host over controlled network. Bandwidth note: delivering 1.5GB over slow site could take hours. :hourglass: 
Sia (Solutions Eng): Commercially we usually offer either (1) annual private deployment subscription + reserved capacity, or (2) perpetual license + paid maintenance. For procurement-limited customers we can propose quarterly invoicing on the subscription path.
Priya (AE): They also flagged they can't accept vendor-kept signing keys. They want customer-held keypair for artifact signing. Is that supported? Any legal/ops caveats?
Mei (Infra Eng): We can support customer-managed signing keys for the bundle signature, but the onboarding requires key exchange steps and an HSM recommendation. Offline root CA rotation is manual — we document the steps. If they insist on keeping keys entirely offline, we'll need a one-time on-site handshake or OOB verification.
Omar (SE): For SBOM and provenance: we can provide an SBOM for each bundle and a signing chain. Example snippet: 
```
artifact: redwood-model-13b-q4-v2026-03.tar.gz
sha256: 12ab34cd...
sbom: redwood-model-13b-q4-v2026-03.sbom.json
signer: customer-key-fingerprint: aa:bb:cc...
```
Priya (AE): Perfect. They asked about upgrades: can we promise only manual apply (no auto-updates)?
Mei (Infra Eng): Yes. Air-gapped flow is always manual apply. Our agent supports `--dry-run` and `--apply` modes. Sample command: `./rw-offline apply --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz --verify-signature`. Rollback: we support snapshot-based rollback but it must be invoked by operator. We do not push forced rollbacks.
Sia (Solutions Eng): Pricing options to put in the deck: Option A: subscription (annual) with two included offline bundles per month + per-bundle engineering beyond that. Option B: perpetual license + paid support blocks (e.g., 40 hours/month). Also offer add-on: on-demand remote assist during their first three installs.
Priya (AE): They care about cadence predictability. Can we commit to a monthly security patch schedule and quarterly model refresh windows? They want the exact day so procurement can schedule maintenance windows.
Omar (SE): We can do "first Wednesday" windows for patches and "first Tuesday of quarter" for model updates if we put it in the SOW. For air-gapped customers we prepare signed minibundles ahead of the window; customer applies them when ready.
ci-bot: Ticket SALES-2119 created: "BigBank airgap POC - package sizing, cadence & key custody" assigned to Omar, Sia.
Mei (Infra Eng): Operational blockers to call out in the proposal: 1) bandwidth/transfer logistics for large artifacts; 2) requirement for an on-prem operator with sudo rights during installs; 3) KMS/HSM recommendations and legal approval if they manage keys; 4) lifecycle for delta patches (we recommend minibundle deltas to reduce downtime).
Priya (AE): Action items: Sia to draft commercial options and SOW language with calendar anchors; Omar to produce minibundle size matrix and sample `rw-offline` commands + short runbook; Mei to draft KMS/HSM onboarding checklist & customer-signing key process for Legal. I'll align with BigBank and book a follow-up call.
Sia (Solutions Eng): Will draft and share by Thu EOD.
Omar (SE): I'll drop the minibundle table here by EOD — will include model-only, runtime+model, and full bundle sizes and expected install times on 100Mbps and 10Mbps links.
Mei (Infra Eng): ETA 48h on key custody / HSM recommendations and any Legal dependency.
Priya (AE): Thanks team — let's keep it tight. I'll prep the customer note with three options and the caveats you called out. :white_check_mark:
